title: RNA extraction from the pennate diatom Asterionella formosa
author: Carine Puppo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nu8dezw

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Equipment
steps.instruction: Ensure all equipment (pipetman, bench, etc.) is decontaminated with RNAse AWAY solution and use RNAse-free tips and tubes. Wear gloves throughout the procedure.

steps.title: Grow and Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Grow 1L of Asterionella formosa culture to an optical density at 600nm (OD 600) of 0.12 and harvest the cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 3,200g for 15 min at 16°C using a swinging rotor

steps.title: Lysis with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of TRIzol Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15596026) to the harvested cells (roughly 360 mg).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 min

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Split the 4 mL TRIzol sample into four 1 mL aliquots in Eppendorf tubes and add chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of pure chloroform to each 1 mL sample (do not use chloroform/isoamyl alcohol substitute)
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min
Centrifuge at maximal speed for 15 min at 4°C in a benchtop microcentrifuge

steps.title: Aqueous Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Collect the aqueous phase (top phase, approx 0.6 mL per tube) from each tube using a needle syringe.

substeps.instruction: Split the collected aqueous phase into aliquots of 200 μL each

steps.title: RNA Dilution and Purification
steps.instruction: Add 375 μL of RNA dilution buffer (blue solution) from the SV Total RNA Isolation System kit (Promega Catalog #Z3100) to each 200 μL aliquot.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximal speed for 10 min at 4°C in a benchtop microcentrifuge
Collect the supernatant (approx 500 μL per tube), noting that a blue pellet may be present

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 250 μL of 90% ethanol (kept at -20°C) to each ~500 μL supernatant sample.

steps.title: Final Isolation
steps.instruction: Proceed from step 7 of the SV Total RNA Isolation System Protocol (Promega Catalog #Z3100).

substeps.instruction: Tip as many tubes as possible (between 12 and 13) into the Spin Basket Assembly
